discovery.title: World's water cycle becoming more unpredictable, UN warns
discovery.summary: The planet's water cycle is becoming increasingly erratic, swinging between too little and too much, the United Nations warned Thursday, with an unprecedented El Niño expected to exacerbate the long-term trend.
